name: types-row-chip-name-info
title: Reorder Types rows: fixed kind chip, name, full info
description: Reorder the Overlay Types row to chip -> name -> info -> actions. The kind badge moves to a fixed leading track and fills it, so Struct / Bit-field / Enum render at identical widths and align. The info (meta) column stops being capped at 58px and becomes content-sized, so the full text shows; the name becomes the flexible cell that ellipsizes (with a title). Presentation only: no sort/filter/behavior, persisted, or naming change.
